$comment: Cosmos Surfaces (granite, quartz and other slabs, US distribution centres) runs an Angular single-page app: the server HTML has no visible product markup, only the <head> metadata (<title>, og:title, og:image, meta description) and a schema.org Product JSON-LD block with price 0.00. Product URLs are /<location>/<material>/<slug> (for example /washington/granite/absolute-black-premium-3cm; 3,370 in product/sitemap.xml, the same stone repeated per location). There is no price (slabs are sold to fabricators through the locations), so price and availability are not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. The fields therefore come from <head>: title is og:title (it carries an SEO prefix and suffix, for example 'Everyday Use Absolute Black Premium 3CM | Granite | Washington, DC'), image is og:image (empty on some products, then FIELD_MISSING), description is the meta description; root is the document, anchored on the JSON-LD block. There are no specs. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title, image and description from the metadata; browser: CONNECTION_FAILED after 95 s (headless Chrome); duckduckgo, mojeek, yandex: SEARCH_PROVIDER_BLOCKED; yahoo: SEARCH_PROVIDER_ERROR; brave: not tried, no key; ai-crawler-avalai: the same three fields with a cleaner title ('Absolute Black Premium 3CM') at 1,449+301 tokens; ai-crawler-cloudflare: not configured. http is selected: the same fields at no cost. Checked against saved (curl) Absolute Black Premium 3CM granite and Calacatta Silver SJ CQ 3CM quartz pages on 2026-11-19.
